scope_basis.a2_1_closure_method: AST local-import closure from the two public function definition files; then include all utils/ as A2.1 explicitly says “+ utils”, package initializers on that path, and the root flat facade needed for opendata_http.<function>. flat_facade_import_side_effect.method: Static AST local-module import reachability from opendata_http/__init__.py in the current port tree; not runtime-tested.
flat_facade_import_side_effect.scope_note: The current public flat facade eagerly reaches 307 packaged Python modules, much wider than the 15-file function-specific A2.1 semantic scope. This is recorded as a runtime import-width caveat and does not silently relabel every reached module as 1A.

b1_1_groups.basis: FR-4/D9 explicit module; recorded separately from futures_daily.

scope_basis.b1_2_on_demand_reason: Files outside the A2.1 function-specific files and B1.1 named packages map to B1.2 remaining-submodule on-demand registration; this is a batch label and does not assign or rewrite domain priority.

reconciliation.method_note: Manifest files/resources were joined by path, not row order. Port-report ✓ statuses are stored report entries; this inventory did not execute report generation, comparison replay, tests, or network calls.

ac6_02_existing_fixture_inventory.mode: offline recorded HTTP replay; command not executed in this inventory
ac6_02_existing_fixture_inventory.case_filter: CLI --only is accepted for --record only; --compare considers all CASES, replays recorded fixtures, and reports pending cases.
ac6_02_existing_fixture_inventory.acceptance_state: INVENTORY_ONLY; existing fixtures and prior compare-report table entries were read; no replay was run; current-code PASS is unverified.
